newsitem.title: UK: Consumer coffee stocks fall end-Sept yr/yr--LMC.
newsitem.headline: Consumer coffee stocks fall end-Sept yr/yr--LMC.

text.p: World consumer coffee stocks rose to 9.10 million 60-kg bags at the end of September from 8.83 million in June but down from 10.94 million a year ago, UK research firm LMC International Ltd said.

The supply situation was acute in the United States where stocks totalled only 1.61 million bags, down from 2.16 million in June and 2.60 million in September last year, LMC said in its November bulletin made available to Reuters on Monday.
Roastings in the U.S. rose to 12.63 million bags in the third quarter of this year from 8.32 million in the previous quater and 12.30 million a year earlier.
European stocks rose to 6.40 million bags at end-September from 5.70 million at end-June, but down from 7.0 million at end-September last year.
LMC gave no European import figures for the just-ended quarter.
Japanese green coffee imports rose slightly to 1.48 million bags in the third quarter from 1.46 million in the second quarter and 1.40 million the same 1995 quarter.
End-September coffee stocks in Japan stood at 1,08 million bags, up from 969,000 at end-June but down from 1.34 million a year ago. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
